name: EH3D-NODE-BUNGARD
stack: C++17 (host-tested core); ESP-IDF firmware for the ESP32-S3 (Ethernet with PoE, or Wi-Fi)
deployment_target: esp32-s3 node inside the box of a Bungard CCD machine
build: cmake -S tests -B build/host && cmake --build build/host && ctest --test-dir build/host -C Debug
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.2: a thin network pipe to the RS-232 control unit of the Bungard CCD MTC and CCD/2 MTC drilling and routing machines (serial-port control units of the DOS software 4.6). A program on the network sends the bytes of a move over a framed TCP link; the node sends them out of its UART at the line's own pace, so the timing no longer depends on a PC or a USB adapter. The rules that keep the machine from moving by accident (login with a token, arming, a stop when the link goes quiet or drops) are in the host-tested core. The firmware has not been built or flashed yet and nothing has been connected to a machine; the protocol itself was tried on a CCD MTC through a USB adapter.
